name: issue-orchestrator
//lifecycle: Split deliberately (#7100). A prebuild bakes onCreateCommand and
updateContentCommand but NOT postCreateCommand, so leaving the expensive
setup in postCreateCommand is why enabling prebuilds appears to do nothing.
onCreate: image prerequisites and tools that do not depend on repo content.
updateContent: lockfile-driven sync — baked by the prebuild AND re-run on
create, which is what closes the drift between a stale prebuild and HEAD.
Both `uv sync --frozen` and `npm ci` converge from any starting state, so
re-running them against a baked tree is cheap and safe.
postStart runs on EVERY resume — keep it near-empty.
